name: Ethereal Blade
body:
School necromancy; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect sword-like beam
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Ethereal blade creates a 3-foot-long sword of swirling energy that springs forth from your hand. The blade strikes as a melee touch attack and inflicts 1d8 points of damage +l point per 2 caster levels (maximum +10) against corporeal and incorporeal undead opponents. The blade is also bone-chillingly cold and inflicts half this damage as cold damage against living opponents.
